metadata.description: CORE — project intelligence in chat with a critic baked in. The `/core` agent plus nine companion utilities.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: CORE — a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Type `/core` to start. Ships with nine companion utilities — `/finalize`, `/process-memory`, `/register-sources`, `/vibecheck`, `/configure-project`, `/metrics` (with full/export/self-test modes), `/memory-view`, and the deprecation shims `/metrics-package` and `/self-test` — that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly.
